subject: Genetics
title: Cystic Fibrosis
description: A quick win: understand Cystic Fibrosis.

hook.text: In the 1950s, children with cystic fibrosis rarely saw age five. Today, median survival is past 50.

buildup.text: CF results from mutations in the CFTR gene. Thick mucus clogs lungs and pancreas. Breathing is a daily fight.

discovery.text: Over 2,000 CFTR mutations exist. The most common deletes one amino acid. One missing piece, massive damage.

twist.text: In 2019, Trikafta—a triple drug combo—fixed the protein in 90% of CF patients. Not a cure but transformative.

climax.text: CF went from a childhood death sentence to a manageable condition in one generation. Science changed the arc.

punchline.text: One amino acid missing. One drug combo changed everything.

quiz.question: What gene is mutated in cystic fibrosis?
